antigravity-cli:gemini-3.1-pro-high.reason: The changed version removes the call to _validate_image, meaning it will no longer raise a ValueError for invalid Image objects, instead returning an ImageMedia object.

antigravity-cli:gemini-3.8-flash-high.reason: None of the allowable input types is an instance of Image.Image, so the modified image validation branch is unreachable and both versions raise TypeError.

claude-cli:claude-sonnet-5.reason: The changed version replaces the call `_validate_image(value)` with `pass`, so any Pillow Image that `_validate_image` would reject (e.g. a degenerate image such as one with zero width/height) raises ValueError in the original but is silently converted to an ImageMedia in the changed version.

claude-cli:claude-sonnet-5-5@low.reason: The change removes the _validate_image(value) call, so an image that the validator rejects with ValueError raises in the original but returns an ImageMedia in the changed version.
